From Summit Harvest to Permanent Statewide Growth

Transforming the high-water mark of October 21 into a self-sustaining 6-month digital flywheel.

Strategic Focus
“Nebraska’s builders, founders, and innovators are the heroes of the story. Tech Nebraska is the guide, connector, and statewide amplifier.”

The annual Tech Nebraska Summit is Nebraska's premiere technology convening. However, high-impact conferences face a universal challenge: massive insight and momentum peak during the event, followed by post-event communication silence.

This engagement solves that dropoff. By deploying an on-site production team to capture high-definition panels, keynote soundbites, and 12–15 structured stakeholder micro-interviews, Tech Nebraska will bank 70 to 100 master story assets. That archive fuels a consistent, high-authority storytelling rhythm from October through April—retaining corporate sponsors, recruiting members, and engaging lawmakers ahead of the 2027 Unicameral session.

Telling Nebraska’s Tech Story, Statewide

Highlighting local builders, members, students, and ecosystem voices across all 93 counties.

Statewide Narrative
Figure 1.0: Tech Nebraska Statewide Storytelling Engine — Capturing stories locally, sharing them statewide.

The Omaha/Lincoln Metro Corridor (LinkedIn Focus)

In downtown Omaha, Aksarben, and Lincoln, the audience is enterprise IT directors, venture capitalists, corporate sponsors, and Unicameral policy influencers. LinkedIn is the undisputed B2B authority channel, currently driving 91.5% of Tech Nebraska’s digital engagement with 3,910 followers.

  • Audience: Enterprise CIOs, startup founders, institutional sponsors, legislators.
  • Content Role: Corporate sponsorship ROI, legislative briefs, executive quotes.
  • Objective: Reach 6,000+ followers and close regional peer gap.

Greater & Rural Nebraska (Facebook Groups Focus)

In Northeast Nebraska (Norfolk, Columbus), Central Nebraska (Kearney, Grand Island), and Western Nebraska (Scottsbluff, North Platte), tech looks different: precision agriculture, robotics, regional manufacturing, and community college STEM programs. These communities do not live on LinkedIn—they live on Facebook.

“Are you interested in tech and staying in the loop across Nebraska? Join our newsletter and explore our membership.”

The Playbook: Proactive community outreach into regional Nebraska Facebook groups to funnel local builders and innovators directly into Tech Nebraska's newsletter and membership pipeline.

The “Link-Dump” Algorithmic Penalty

Historical audit of Tech Nebraska's social engagement patterns.

Audit Finding

Our forensic audit revealed that 48% of historical posts dumped bare external URLs directly into post text. External links trigger algorithmic suppression across modern feeds.

Publishing Format Historical Usage Median Reactions Performance Impact
Link-Dump (Bare URL) 48% of posts 12 -81% Algorithmic Suppression
Native Photo Gallery / Document 34% of posts 45 +275% Engagement
Native Video Reel / Short 18% of posts 65+ +441% Organic Reach Lift

The Creative Content Gap: Elevating Event Storytelling

Moving from static flyers to broadcast-grade, short-form narrative reels.

Creative Production

The Past Baseline (What We Are Replacing):

  • Static flyer screenshots of PDF agendas and schedules.
  • Phone photos captured from the back of dark presentation rooms.
  • Text-heavy announcements with external registration links.
  • Complete communication freeze within 5 days after the summit ends.

The XPM Production Standard:

  • Broadcast 4K keynote & panel capture with crystal-clear audio.
  • 12–15 structured, high-energy attendee & sponsor micro-interviews.
  • Dynamic 9:16 vertical short-form reels with custom stylized typography.
  • Turnkey distribution kits provided directly to corporate sponsors.
